name: EZCursorVR
summary: A 2D cursor on a plane in front of the user, moved with head motion or a gamepad, for selecting targets in VR headsets.
howItWorks: Instead of aiming a ray, the user moves a cursor across a 2D plane; the object under the cursor from the user's viewpoint is selected.
